versions.subject: CobaltStrike Service Installations in Registry
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services'
selection2:
    Details|contains|all: 
        - 'ADMIN$'
        - '.exe'
selection3:
    Details|contains|all:
        - '%COMSPEC%'
        - 'start'
        - 'powershell'
condition: selection1 and (selection2 or selection3)
